prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Jason D’s Vision location master source, wide landscape, later cropped to 16:9 and centered 4:5.
Primary request: An original photorealistic artistic interpretation of Campo del Sur and Cádiz old town at 22:33 Europe/Madrid on 23 September 2026, from the public seawall promenade near 36.5282,-6.2996, eye level looking east-northeast toward Cádiz Cathedral. It is Night. Open-Meteo model valid 22:30: mainly clear, 25.2°C, 8% cloud, no precipitation, strong 27.6 km/h wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Sun below horizon at elevation -26.68°, azimuth 292.04°; no direct sunlight.
Scene/backdrop: Dark Atlantic water with wind-driven surface texture and small irregular whitecaps occupies the lower/right foreground. A rough stone breakwater and Campo del Sur seawall curve strongly from lower left toward the old-town waterfront. A continuous low row of pale, ochre and muted pastel historic façades follows the curve. Cádiz Cathedral rises clearly above them with ONE large pale-gold tiled central dome and TWO comparable bell towers; the dome is broad but not gigantic.
Composition/framing: Public ground-level promenade view, not drone and not from the water. Keep the cathedral group, main waterfront row and decisive seawall curve inside the central 43% of a wide 16:9 frame so a centered portrait crop retains them. Ample sea foreground and near-black sky. The viewpoint should read as the iconic Campo del Sur approach, with real coastal scale.
Lighting/mood: Mostly clear dark night, no moon or stars. Restrained warm lamps along the seawall and façades, cathedral softly lit as supported by historical night photos; illumination tonight is not verified, so avoid spectacular floodlighting. Wind roughens the water; promenade and buildings stay dry because precipitation is zero.
Constraints: Cádiz, not Havana or another generic waterfront. No tropical skyline, no marina boats, no sandy beach, no giant waves over the wall, no rain, no wet paving, no crowds or identifiable people, no logos or readable signs. No text, caption, signature, border or watermark.

architectural_anchors: Rough Atlantic water and dark stone breakwater/seawall curve from foreground toward the old-town waterfront
Cádiz Cathedral has one large pale-gold tiled dome and two similar bell towers above the waterfront roofs
A continuous low row of pale and ochre historic façades lines Campo del Sur between cathedral and seawall
